§6Fission Fuels§f

§aThe fuels that power your reactors.§f
NuclearCraft has a whole catalog of fission fuels, from basic §bLEU-233§f and §bHEU-235§f to exotic §bMOX§f and §bThoriium§f fuels. Each fuel has different burn times, heat generation, and efficiency ratings. Check JEI for the full list.

Your first reactor will probably run on §bLEU-233§f or §bLEU-235§f. These are produced by processing uranium through the §bIsotope Separator§f and then the §bChemical Reactor§f.

§cWARNING:§f Higher-tier fuels generate more heat. Make sure your cooling can handle it before upgrading fuel grades. Meltdowns are expensive.

§ePS:§f Start with low-enriched fuels and work your way up as your reactor design improves.
